baslik: 100 bodies to be buried in mass grave inside Gaza's Al-Shifa Hospital
metin:
The Palestinian Health Ministry announced plans to dig a mass grave at Al-Shifa Hospital on Saturday to bury approximately 100 bodies currently held there. Dr. Munir Al-Borsh, the ministry's Director General, reported to Al Jazeera that "Israeli bombing around the hospital has not stopped for three nights" and described the situation as trapped, stating "We are trapped inside the Al-Shifa complex."

He detailed relentless bombardment occurring nearly continuously, designed to facilitate military entry into the hospital complex. The bombing has prevented ambulances from reaching the facility, creating a humanitarian crisis.

Doctors Without Borders corroborated the deteriorating conditions, noting "the attacks against Al-Shifa Hospital have dramatically intensified" and that staff observed "a catastrophic situation inside."

The Israeli military has conducted escalating operations against multiple Gaza hospitals, including Indonesian Hospital, Al-Awda Hospital, Al-Quds Hospital, and Al-Rantisi Children's Hospital. These campaigns follow Hamas's October 7 cross-border attack.

Casualty figures cited indicate at least 11,078 Palestinians killed, comprising 4,506 children and 3,027 women, while Israeli deaths numbered approximately 1,200 according to official reports.
